people.imagined: The evening after the bell, in the cold upper hall. She has just put her cold hands round a bowl of snow-melt tea that she cannot feel, and is listening to a novice's footsteps in the corridor, smiling a little before she knows who it is.
people.subject: The moment: in a cold, bare upper hall at evening, a very old abbess holds a bowl of snow-melt tea in both hands and looks up with a warm smile, listening to a novice's footsteps before she knows who it is. Face, most important: a small, delicate, very old face, the skin thin and pale as rice paper with a faint blue tint, a thousand fine wrinkles around kind, bright, dark eyes, a soft mouth and a tiny straight nose; the smile is warm but the hands are visibly cold, with white fingertips and a faint frost on the knuckles. Hair: none, the head shaved and smooth beneath a sheer white hood. Body: small and narrow, the spine perfectly straight, sitting very upright. Clothing: the abbess's richest dress of Lê Hoa Am: layered robes of undyed white wool-silk with three crossed collars and wide sleeves, tied with a white sash hung with a pale jade pendant; over her shoulders a sheer white veil-robe that drifts like blossom and shimmers with rime, pear blossoms embroidered in white at every hem; a string of pale pear-wood beads at her left wrist. Hands and objects: a white porcelain bowl of steaming tea held in both hands, the steam freezing into thin mist; at her elbow on a low table a small bronze bell the size of a pear, dull green with a pale ice sheen, and beside it her sword, the Moonrime sword, in a white scabbard frosted pale blue with a silver guard. Power: a soft ice-blue aura and slow drifting motes of frost gather about her shoulders, strong for a Kết Đan abbess. Background: dark mist and the pale blue of a high window. Light: cool moonlit spirit-light from the upper left, a faint warmth rising from the tea, a pale rim of silver along the veil. Expression: a calm, warm smile that reaches the eyes, soft and unhurried, with a deep weariness settled under it.

people.imagined: At the gate at dawn, in front of the visitor who has come uninvited. She has laid her left hand on the hilt of a pear-wood sword and has not drawn it; she copies the vow each morning and believes every word of it.
people.subject: The moment: standing squarely in a gateway at dawn, a prioress stares down at the viewer with one hand on a sword hilt, not drawing it. Face, most important: a face like a closed door: a long, flat, still face, high pale forehead, deep-set black eyes giving nothing, a long straight nose, thin lips pressed in an unmoving line, a vertical line between the brows; no expression, no age beyond a few fine lines. Hair: iron grey, drawn back tight into a plain low knot and pinned with a single carved white-jade pin. Body: tall, straight and spare, shoulders squared in the doorway. Clothing: the elder's dress of the grey sisters of Lê Hoa Am: long layered robes of soft dove-grey silk with three crossed collars and wide sleeves, a dark-grey sash hung with a silver pendant, white pear blossoms embroidered along the hem and cuffs, over them a sheer grey gauze outer robe edged with steel-grey brocade; a string of one hundred and eight grey beads wound around the left wrist, the old miner's stitching of iron thread still visible along one hem. Hands and objects: her left hand grips the pale pear-wood hilt of a thin grey sword in a plain scabbard at her hip; her right hand hangs open at her side, the fingertips stained black with ink. Power: a cold steel-grey sheen runs along the scabbard and a faint ice-blue mist curls at her feet, the aura of a Kết Đan elder, held in. Background: the dark timber of a gate dissolving into drifting mist and pale sky. Light: cold white dawn and spirit-light from the upper left, a thin silver rim on the shoulders. Expression: closed, absolute, unblinking.

people.imagined: Ringing the bell at night. She has just struck it and, with her eyes closed, hums its note back without knowing she is doing it, her fingers dusted with fine jade.
people.subject: The moment: standing by a bronze bell, a true disciple strikes it and hums the note with eyes closed, mouth gently open. Face, most important: a round, soft, plump-cheeked face, pink with cold, an open humming mouth; fine green-white jade dust plainly lodged in the creases of the knuckles of both hands held before her; closed eyelids, thick dark lashes, a gentle small nose, soft short brows and a tiny white scar at the left corner of her mouth. Hair: none, the head shaved smooth beneath a sheer white hood. Body: round-shouldered and sturdy, a little short. Clothing: the dress of a white nun of Lê Hoa Am: layered undyed white wool-silk robes with two crossed collars, wide sleeves pushed back to the wrists, a white sash with a small jade pendant, pear blossoms embroidered in white at the hem; a string of pale pear-wood beads on the left wrist, a slightly richer white gauze over-robe marking a true disciple. Hands and objects: a padded wooden striker in her right hand; before her a dull bronze bell hung from a great timber beam with a coil of rope, pale ice crystals frozen on its lip; her knuckles dusted pale green. Power: each stroke sends a faint ring of ice-blue light rippling outward from the bell, with a few drifting motes of frost. Background: a night of drifting mist, blue snow and hard stars seen through an open arch. Light: cool silver starlight and spirit-light from the upper left, a dim warm lamp, a thin line of rime flashing on the bell edge. Expression: absorbed, humble and gentle.

people.imagined: At the gate in the afternoon glare, with a basket of larch mushrooms on the ground in front of her. She takes it, as she does every spring, and has just turned the man away.
people.subject: The moment: standing in the glare of the gate, a captain of the grey sisters faces the viewer squarely with a woven basket of larch mushrooms at her feet, a hand on a short sword. Face, most important: a deeply sunburnt face, red-brown, peeling across the nose and cheekbones from the gate's glare, a broad strong jaw, squinting, a short flat nose, thin dark brows; wide, level, hard brown eyes narrowed to dark slits. A band of pale untanned skin runs across her forehead where a silk headband sits, her lips are chapped and split. Hair: black, in a thick low knot held with a plain silver pin, wrapped in a soft grey silk headcloth. Body: broad in the shoulder, strong, squat; thick arms. She stands with feet planted shoulder-width apart and chest forward, a soldier's stance. Clothing: the dress of a grey sister of Lê Hoa Am, cut for a captain: layered dove-grey silk robes with two crossed collars, the wide sleeves bound back with silver-grey cords, a dark sash hung with a steel-grey jade pendant, white pear blossoms embroidered at the hem, a short sheer grey gauze over-vest edged in steel-grey brocade. Hands and objects: her right hand rests on the hilt of a short, broad grey sword with a silver guard; a round basket at her feet full of pale brown mushrooms. Power: a faint steel-grey glimmer of Metal qi rides the sword's edge, a few cold motes of light about her hand. Background: dark gate posts with a snow-capped crossbar fading into white mist, a line of small footprints leading away. Light: hard white spirit-light from the upper left glaring off the snow, bouncing under her jaw, a pale rim of silver. Expression: a stern, squinting stare, a hard set to the mouth and an impatient tightening of the jaw, loyal to a rule she will not bend.

people.imagined: On the glacier terrace among cracks of snow lotus, kneeling over a basket of salves for the miners. She crushes a petal between her fingers and smells it, then turns to the viewer, smiling.
people.subject: The moment: kneeling among snow lotus on a glacier terrace, a healer with a crushed white petal between her fingers turns and smiles at the viewer. Face, most important: a warm, wide, lined, comfortable face rosy with cold, deep laugh-lines, a wide kind mouth and a snub nose; the sleeves of her robe carry neat appliqué squares of silk in many colours, green, rust, yellow and blue, one square for every salve she makes, plainly visible as she reaches. Hair: none, the head shaved beneath a sheer white hood, a few stubbly grey hairs showing at its edge above the ears. Body: stocky and sturdy, kneeling easily with her skirts bunched in the snow, one hand on the basket. Clothing: the dress of a white nun of Lê Hoa Am: layered undyed white wool-silk robes with two crossed collars and wide sleeves, the coloured silk squares set in tidy rows along both sleeves, a white sash with a small green jade pendant, white pear blossoms embroidered at the hem; a string of pale pear-wood beads. Hands and objects: at her side a basket of small clay pots with cloth lids; in her hand a white snow-lotus flower with one petal crushed. Power: a soft ice-blue glow and a few green motes of Wood qi drift up from the crushed petal and her fingers. Background: a cleft of blue ice in drifting mist, pale lotus flowers glowing in the cracks at several heights; far off a lower terrace and a track of footprints leading down towards a small smoke-blue village. Light: bright cold spirit-light from the upper left, a silvery gleam picking out the veins of the petals and the ice crystals on her hood. Expression: a broad, easy, generous smile, relaxed brows and patient eyes, entirely at home.

people.imagined: At her desk in the book-room, she has dipped the brush and lifted her head from forty years of bending over it, eyes the washed blue of old ink, to see who has come.
people.subject: The moment: seated at a low desk with a brush lifted, an old keeper of records raises her head slowly from the page and meets the viewer's eyes. Face, most important: her neck bent forward in a permanent stoop, the head carried low and out in front of the shoulders like a heron; a long, thin, gentle face, deep lines at the mouth, a thin straight nose; pale washed-blue eyes, the colour of old ink, faded and kind; fine white eyebrows and a few white lashes. Hair: none, the head shaved under a sheer white hood. Body: thin, bowed, narrow shoulders. Clothing: the dress of a white nun of Lê Hoa Am: layered undyed white wool-silk robes with a high crossed collar, wide sleeves tied back with white cords, a white sash with a small pale jade pendant, white pear blossoms embroidered at the hem; the right cuff is stained with a fine speckling of black ink; soft white slippers under the hem. Hands and objects: a long brush with a black tip held in the right hand; a thick book of many thin pages open on the desk; an ink-stone. Power: a few pale ice-blue motes float up from the open page like breath. Background: a wall of shelves with rows of bound volumes dissolving into mist, a shuttered window with a strip of grey light, a tiny brazier with a thin plume of smoke. Light: pale moonlit spirit-light from the upper left falls cold over her bowed neck, a little warm lamp glow edging the desk and brush. Expression: a slow, gentle look from washed-blue eyes, the thin mouth softened and unhurried, tired lines of long patient work easing as she sees who has come.

people.imagined: In the glacier's blue corridor, a black pebble in her sleeve. She is drawing lots for a berth and has just raised her left hand, the two lost fingertips showing, to show the pebble she drew.
people.subject: The moment: standing in a corridor of blue glacial ice, a white nun raises her left hand to show the viewer a small black pebble held between finger and thumb. Face, most important: the left hand held up shows two blunt, shortened fingertips, the ends missing and scarred smooth and white from frostbite; a long, composed, pale face, high cheekbones, heavy lids, a calm, arbitrary mouth, unmoving dark eyes. A thin film of frost whitens her brows and the fine hair at her temples, her lips are pale and slightly blue, a fine white scar crosses her chin. Hair: none, the head shaved smooth under a sheer white hood. Body: tall, slender, unhurried. Clothing: the dress of a white nun of Lê Hoa Am: layered undyed white wool-silk robes with two crossed collars, wide quilted cuffs, a white sash with a pale jade pendant, white pear blossoms embroidered at the hem, a faint rime on the shoulders; a string of pale pear-wood beads. Hands and objects: a black pebble between thumb and finger; a small lantern with a pale flame hung at her belt. Power: a thin ice-blue aura clings to her like breath on glass, motes of frost turning slowly about her raised hand. Background: glacier walls of deep translucent blue with trapped bubbles and a row of shallow niches, a pale white-wrapped shape lying in the nearest one, all fading into mist. Light: cold blue spirit-light from the upper left glowing from the ice, the lantern making one small yellow spot. Expression: a calm, pale face with level eyes and a closed, unreadable mouth; nothing in it shows whether the pebble she holds up is luck or doom.

people.imagined: The mine road at night. She knocks twice on a stone wall before leaning on it, as she has since the shaft fell, and the knock echoes. She glances at the viewer, one hand on a hidden hoard.
people.subject: The moment: on a mine road at night, a grey sister knocks twice with her knuckles on a rock wall before leaning her shoulder to it, then looks at the viewer. Face, most important: her left ear is notched, a deep scar-bitten gap taken from the rim, plainly visible with the hair pulled back off it, and a long pale shaft-fall scar runs from the ear to the jaw; a lean, tough, weathered face, a short nose, thin lips, hard dark eyes, a greedy glint. Hair: black with grey, tied in a tight knot under a soft grey silk headcloth and a plain silver pin. Body: wiry, hard, weight on one shoulder. Clothing: the dress of a grey sister of Lê Hoa Am: layered dove-grey silk robes with two crossed collars and wide sleeves bound back at the wrist with grey cords, a dark sash hung with a steel-grey jade pendant, white pear blossoms embroidered at the hem; a bundle of candle ends tied at her belt. Hands and objects: the knuckles of her right hand against rock; a short sword in a plain scabbard at her hip; a lantern with a stub of candle. Power: a faint steel-grey and ochre shimmer of Metal and Earth qi clings to her knuckles where they touch the stone. Background: a rocky mine road and timber props dissolving into blue-black mist, a few snow flurries drifting through the lantern's glow. Light: a dim candle-glow and cold spirit-light from the upper left, a thin silver rim along her jaw. Expression: a sidelong, sharp look with a stubborn set to the jaw and one brow slightly raised, watchful and not quite warm.

people.imagined: At the gate, a carter's boy at her elbow and two coppers pressed into his palm. She looks to the viewer with a very reasonable face and a cowlick that will not go flat.
people.subject: The moment: at a gate, a young grey sister passes two coppers to a boy just out of frame and smiles brightly at the viewer. Face, most important: a stubborn cowlick sticks straight up from the crown of her head through the grey silk headcloth, a tuft of black hair standing like a feather, impossible to miss; a pretty, round, clever face, bright dark eyes, a quick wide smile, a small mole beside the nose, small freckles across the nose. Hair: black, in a bun under a grey silk headcloth, the cowlick sticking up; tiny jade studs in her pierced ears. Body: slender, quick, easy. She stands lightly with one hip cocked, a hand half-hidden at her back. Clothing: the simplest graceful dress of a grey sister of Lê Hoa Am: layered dove-grey silk robes with two crossed collars and wide sleeves, a dark sash hung with a small purse and a green jade bead, white pear blossoms embroidered at the hem, a thin green ribbon sewn at the cuff, a pale grey inner collar. Hands and objects: two small copper coins between her fingers; a sheathed sword at her hip. Background: gate posts streaked with frost in drifting mist, a cart-track leading down through pale birch trees, a boy's small dark shape by the post. Light: bright cold spirit-light from the upper left, a pale blue glow of snow under her chin. Expression: a bright, ready smile and a wide, reasonable gaze, one eyebrow lifted with a flicker of slyness at the corner of the mouth.

people.imagined: Setting out down the mine road with a letter bag over her shoulder, pulling her left sleeve back to show something to a friend, and then hiding it. She trusts the prioress and thinks opening the bag is the rule.
people.subject: The moment: shouldering a letter bag on a snowy mine road, a young grey sister turns, smiles trustingly at the viewer and lifts her left sleeve cuff a little. Face, most important: just inside the cuff a clan-green silk ribbon the width of a finger is sewn, bright green against the grey silk, shown for a second; her face is round, open and fresh, with rosy cheeks, a short nose, big trusting hazel eyes and a gap-toothed smile, her nose and ears red with cold and a tiny new freckle at the corner of her left eye. Hair: light brown, in a long plait over her shoulder tied with a grey silk ribbon. Body: slender, young and brisk, walking with a spring in her step, shoulders back and arms swinging. Clothing: the simplest graceful dress of a grey sister of Lê Hoa Am: layered dove-grey silk robes with two crossed collars and wide sleeves, a dark sash knotted in a small bow, white pear blossoms embroidered at the hem, a soft pale scarf of fine knit, a band of bright silk at the boot edge. Hands and objects: a leather letter bag with a flap on a strap over her shoulder; a short sword at her hip. Background: the mine road winding down a white slope between rocks and pines in mist, a thin curl of smoke from a village far below. Light: bright winter spirit-light from the upper left, pale gold on one side of her face, her breath a visible white puff. Expression: an eager, open, friendly smile and bold bright eyes, certain that everyone she meets is on her side.

people.imagined: Climbing at dusk above the gate when she should be coughing in her bunk. She has stopped and looked down at her hands with a laugh that arrives late; green grit under every nail.
people.subject: The moment: pausing on a snow slope above the gate, a young grey sister laughs a beat late and shows the viewer her hands. Face, most important: the nails of both raised hands are lined with jade-green grit, a dark pale-green crescent under every nail, plainly visible; a sharp, bright, ambitious face, narrow chin, a long nose, quick eyes, a wide smile that arrives half a second late, a streak of grey rock dust along one cheekbone, a small split in her lower lip and a narrow pale scar through her left eyebrow. Hair: black, in a bun under a grey silk headcloth. Body: lean, sinewy, mid-climb, leaning into the slope on one hand, knees bent, weight on her toes. Clothing: the simplest graceful dress of a grey sister of Lê Hoa Am: dove-grey silk robes with two crossed collars and wide sleeves, the hem wet from snow, white pear blossoms embroidered at the border, a dark sash with a small jade pendant, a pale cotton cough-cloth tucked in the sleeve, a coil of thin silver-grey rope across her chest. Hands and objects: both hands open before her; a short sword at her back. Power: a faint steel-grey and ochre glimmer of Metal qi around her fingertips. Background: a snow slope narrowing to a jagged ridge, a thin cloud catching pink, the gate and a tiny dark roof far below in mist. Light: low rose and violet spirit-light from the upper left, a cold blue shadow filling the hollow behind her. Expression: a quick, late laugh with eyes bright and sharp, the wide mouth thrown open, impatient energy in her whole upturned face.

people.imagined: Late at night copying names. She has licked the brush again, and her lip is black; the new white robe is still stiff and creases like paper. She looks up and begins to write the miners' names she was told not to.
people.subject: The moment: seated writing, a white novice looks up from a page with a brush at her lips. Face, most important: her lips and the tip of her tongue stained black with ink, plainly dark, a black smear at the corner of the mouth and chin; a gentle round pale face, a small nose, wide, earnest eyes; a shaved head, the scalp pale blue-white; a small bead of ink on her left cheek, her cheeks pinkish from the lamp's warmth. Hair: none, shaved, bare, with a sheer white hood fallen back. Body: slight, sitting upright. Clothing: the simplest graceful dress of a white nun of Lê Hoa Am, brand new: layered undyed white wool-silk robes with two crossed collars, so crisp that the folds stand out sharply like paper, wide sleeves, a white sash, white pear blossoms embroidered at the hem; a string of pale beads. Her fingertips are blackened to the second joint with ink. Hands and objects: a fine brush in the right hand; a long scroll of names unrolled on the desk, beside it a small lacquer box with fine brushes and a cake of ink in a saucer. Power: a few pale ice-blue motes drift from the wet ink of the names. Background: a lamp-lit wall dissolving into mist, low shelves of scrolls tied in white cord, a paper screen showing the shadow of snowflakes. Light: a soft pool of amber lamp-glow on the desk, cool blue moonlit spirit-light from the screen touching her scalp. Expression: wide, earnest eyes lifted from the page, brows soft and drawn together, a gentle, tired mouth smudged black.

people.imagined: At the grindstone at dawn, a long sword half finished, sparks flying. She will not let go of the wheel until the blade is done, and she snarls a smile with a chipped front tooth at whoever is watching.
people.subject: The moment: bent over a grindstone as sparks fly off a sword blade, a grey novice looks up and bares her teeth in a wrathful grin. Face, most important: a chipped front tooth, a clear triangular notch broken from one upper incisor, shown in a snarl; a strong, square, freckled face, thick brows pulled down, hard black eyes, a stub nose; fine white nicks and spark scars on both forearms, clearly visible, the sleeves rolled up. A thin line of ash-grey dust lies in the creases of her forehead, her nostrils flare. Hair: black, cropped short under a grey silk headband. Body: stocky, strong-armed, braced. Clothing: the simplest graceful dress of a grey sister of Lê Hoa Am, tucked up for work: dove-grey silk robes with two crossed collars, the wide sleeves rolled to the elbow and pinned, a dark sash, white pear blossoms embroidered at the hem, a sheer grey gauze overskirt scorched at the edge with a few tiny spark holes. Hands and objects: a long plain steel sword blade pressed to a stone wheel, orange sparks showering; one foot on the pedal; at her feet a bucket of dark water with a short sword half submerged, steam rising. Power: the sparks trail faint steel-grey Metal qi, glittering motes that outlast their fire. Background: a stone workshop in mist, swords hung on a rack in order of length, a high narrow window letting in a cold bar of dawn. Light: orange spark glow from below lighting her chin, cold dawn spirit-light from the upper left putting a blue edge on her head. Expression: a snarling grin showing the chipped tooth, brows pulled low, her hard black eyes absorbed and fierce, sparks reflected in them.

people.imagined: In the miners' hut with a crushed hand in hers, glass phials rattling in the satchel at her hip, her ears red with chilblains. She has said aloud she would rather stay below.
people.subject: The moment: sitting at a miner's bench in a hut, a young herb nun holds an injured hand in a clean cloth and looks up with an earnest frown. Face, most important: both ears are bright red and swollen with chilblains, glowing against the white hood and twice their natural size; her face is young, open and round, with wind-chapped pink cheeks, fine frost lines in her brows, a broad nose, honest brown eyes and a mouth set to say something unwelcome. Hair: none, the head shaved under a sheer white hood pushed back. Body: sturdy, kneeling on one knee on a straw mat and leaning over the hand, her broad back curved with care. Clothing: the simplest graceful dress of a white nun of Lê Hoa Am: layered undyed white wool-silk robes with two crossed collars, the wide sleeves tied back, a white sash with a small jade pendant, white pear blossoms embroidered at the hem, a clean white apron-sash with a smear of salve; a pear-wood bead string. Hands and objects: a roll of bandage in one hand; at her hip a satchel packed with small glass phials, each stoppered with wax. Power: a soft green and ice-blue glow of Wood and Water qi gathers at her palm over the wound. Background: a low miner's hut in mist, a lamp on a hook, a bench loaded with pots of salve, the pale outline of a miner with a bandaged hand sitting very still. Light: warm lamp-glow from the upper left meeting the cold blue spirit-light of the open doorway, the two tones meeting on her cheek. Expression: a frank, steady, caring frown, the lips pressed as if about to say she would rather stay below, her eyes warm all the same.

people.imagined: In the loft, hiding with a tune; a broom abandoned downstairs. She holds her breath so the song will not leave and her throat bobs.
people.subject: The moment: in a loft with her cheeks puffed, a grey novice holds back a tune, her throat jumping, and smirks at the viewer. Face, most important: her throat bobs visibly, a plain lump at the neck above the collar, a swallowed note; her face is round, freckled and merry, with a snub nose, quick bright light-brown eyes, lips pressed tight and trembling at the corners, a wisp of straw stuck to her lip and a small gap between her front teeth. Hair: black and wild, in a messy loose braid with straw in it, a single silver pin slipping out, no headcloth. Body: lithe and loose, sitting cross-legged on a sack, shoulders shaking slightly with the held-in song, toes curling in the straw. Clothing: the simplest graceful dress of a grey sister of Lê Hoa Am, rumpled from lying in the hay: dove-grey silk robes with two crossed collars, open at the throat, wide sleeves falling loose, the dark sash tied carelessly and half undone, white pear blossoms embroidered at the hem; the grey silk headcloth hangs round her neck; bare feet stick out below the hem. Hands and objects: a sheathed short sword abandoned behind her; a broom handle at the edge of the frame. Background: a dusty loft with beams in soft mist, sacks of dried herbs, a small round window with a patch of blue sky and a small brown bird on the sill. Light: a slanting shaft of soft spirit-light from the skylight at the upper left makes the drifting dust glitter around her like motes. Expression: a mischievous, bursting, barely contained grin, eyes sparkling and sliding toward the viewer.

people.imagined: On the east slope at dawn, squinting at the rising sun, golden pupils glinting; she is the first Light-rooted novice and no one knows what to teach her.
people.subject: The moment: standing at dawn on an east-facing slope, a grey novice squints at the rising sun, then fixes the viewer with a proud gaze. Face, most important: her pupils are bright gold, two clear amber-gold discs shining in the eyes, unmistakable, the gold spreading in thin rays into the iris; her face is fine-boned, pale and narrow, with a small arrogant chin, a high nose, pale lashes, a thin firm upper lip, cheeks slightly flushed and a squint creasing her brow. Hair: black, in a tight plait pinned up with a small silver pin, no headcloth. Body: slender and rigid, chin high, shoulders squared, the stance of a girl who has been told she is special and fears being told otherwise. Clothing: the simplest graceful dress of a grey sister of Lê Hoa Am: layered dove-grey silk robes with two crossed collars and wide sleeves, well fitted, a dark sash hung with a small jade pendant, white pear blossoms embroidered at the hem. Hands and objects: one hand lifted to shade her eyes; the other rests on a short plain sword at her hip. Power: faint warm-gold motes of Light float in the air before her eyes and along the edge of her sleeve, the first sign of an unlooked-for gift. Background: a vast white slope falling away in mist, tinted pink and gold, a low band of cloud across the valley with the sun just rising out of it. Light: low golden sunrise spirit-light from the upper left, dazzling; the sun just behind her left shoulder throws a bright rim on her hair and a strong gold gleam into her eyes. Expression: a proud, guarded stare, the mouth tight, a little defiant, wary under the pride.

people.imagined: In the book-room, kneeling to read the names of the dead azaleas of her village, murmuring. The white robe swamps her. She looks up shyly, flat plain face and a mole on her cheek.
people.subject: The moment: kneeling before a book, the newest white nun murmurs a name and looks up shyly at the viewer. Face, most important: a flat, plain, homely round face with a dark mole like a dropped seed on one cheek, clearly visible, with a single short hair; small close-set eyes, a wide nose, fine frost-white fleck in the dark thin brows, heavy soft cheeks; no beauty, only sincerity. Hair: none, shaved under a sheer white hood. Body: short, heavy, shoulders lost in the robe, kneeling on a thin cushion with her knees together, shoulders rounded as though trying to take up as little space as possible. Clothing: the simplest graceful dress of a white nun of Lê Hoa Am, a size too large: layered undyed white wool-silk robes with two crossed collars, wide sleeves drooping over her hands, a white sash gathered in folds, white pear blossoms embroidered at the hem; a string of pale beads. Hands and objects: a thin white sleeve-end holding a page of the book; a single pink azalea petal tucked in it. Background: a dim room in mist, a low desk with a lamp, shelves of bound books, a vase with one pale pink azalea branch, a narrow window onto a slope of snow under a dim sky. Light: a soft gold lamp-glow on her face and sleeves, a faint ice-blue moonlit rim from the window, the corners of the room deep grey. Expression: a shy, upward glance with a small, uncertain smile and lowered shoulders, the plain face open and sincere.

people.imagined: On the gate step at dawn with the broom. She counts the men who come; she is counting the viewer.
people.subject: The moment: sweeping a gate step at dawn, the youngest grey sister stops and leans on the broom, counting the viewer with her eyes. Face, most important: a long, steady, cold stare, the eyes narrowed and measuring and one brow lifted; a small, thin, sharp-chinned face, pale, with a narrow nose, tight lips, a faint horizontal crease between the brows from constant thinking, thin pale eyebrows and a small bead of cold at the tip of her nose; a faint smile of calculation. Hair: black, in two small buns under a grey silk headcloth, a few loose hairs sticking up at the back. Body: thin and small, standing with her feet together, her back stiff and her weight on the heel of the broom. Clothing: the simplest graceful dress of a grey sister of Lê Hoa Am: layered dove-grey silk robes with two crossed collars and wide sleeves, a dark sash with a small silver bell on a tassel, white pear blossoms embroidered at the hem, a clean white sash-apron. Hands and objects: a broom handle polished to the shape of her palm, gripped in both hands. Slung across the back, past the right shoulder, rises the hilt of a plain short slim sword, its grip wrapped in a strip of dove-grey silk, a small plain guard of grey steel, a plain unpainted scabbard of pale wood worn smooth at the mouth, and a single pale pear-wood bead on the pommel. Background: the huge dark timber posts of a gate in drifting mist, a snow-dusted stone step swept clean in a half-circle, a long white road falling away down the hill with two tiny figures far off. Light: pale early spirit-light from the upper left falls flat across the snow so that the dark gate is the only strong shape. Expression: a cool, shrewd, unreadable look, the mouth closed, giving nothing away while weighing everything.

people.imagined: 702, the foot of the sealed mountain. She stands with the cut ice and the new-cast bell beside her, white hair loose, having sealed the empty cave. She has written the vow and is looking up at it.
people.subject: The moment: standing in snow before a sealed cave mouth, a bronze bell beside her, the founder looks up at the sky with grave calm. Face, most important: her hair is pure white, long and loose, blown back, snow-white from the night of the pear-blossom snow; a long, serene, noble face, high brow, quiet pale lips pressed in the shape of a vow she has just written, fine lines around the eyes, deep dark eyes that look far away, a stillness in her. Hair: white, long and loose to the waist, a single white pear blossom pinned over the ear with a silver pin, a few white petals resting on her shoulders. Body: tall, slender, straight, perfectly still with her feet together, one shoulder slightly lower. Clothing: a founder's immortal robes of Lê Hoa Am in their richest form: flowing layers of undyed white silk with three crossed collars and very wide sleeves that fall in long folds, a pale grey brocade sash hung with white jade pendants and tassels, a sheer white veil-robe drifting like blossom, pear blossoms embroidered in white and silver along every border. Hands and objects: a plain sword with a dark hilt held upright in both hands before her, point down, the way another woman would hold a child. Power: a soft ice-blue aura and slow motes of frost and petals rise about her, the quiet strength of a long-dead master. Background: a dark cave mouth filled with a wall of neatly stacked stones in drifting mist, a small bronze bell the size of a drum in the snow with a skin of ice, white petals drifting through the air. Light: soft moonlit spirit-light from the upper left. Painted as an old memorial portrait: faded and yellowed like an old silk painting, edges darkened, fine cracks. Expression: a grave, quiet face lifted toward the sky, lips closed, deep dark eyes steady and calm with a sorrow she does not hide.

people.imagined: 771, the Gate Hermitage's step, the snow falling. She has found a child sitting in the snow, and is bending to speak in her slow voice, one eyelid never quite closed.
people.subject: The moment: bending over, in falling snow, to speak slowly to someone small just out of frame, a former abbess gazes kindly and level. Face, most important: one eyelid, the left, never fully closes, a half-open slit showing the white of the eye, clearly visible; a broad, calm, slow-moving face, wide cheeks, a broad nose, a gentle wide mouth, deep lines from her nose to the corners of her mouth, short lashes, snowflakes settled on her brows. Hair: none, the head shaved under a sheer white hood. Body: large, broad, gentle, stooped forward, bending at the waist with one hand on her knee, a large woman moving carefully, weight on her heels. Clothing: the abbess's rich dress of Lê Hoa Am: layered undyed white wool-silk robes with three crossed collars and wide sleeves, a white brocade sash hung with a pale jade pendant, a sheer white veil-robe over the shoulders, pear blossoms embroidered in white and silver at every hem; a dark grey silk shawl folded under it, and the pear-wood beads wound three times round her wrist. Hands and objects: her right hand held out open, palm up, with snowflakes falling on it. Power: the falling snowflakes glow faintly ice-blue as they touch her palm, a soft aura of frost about her. Background: falling snow and mist, timber gate posts looming out of it, a small lantern hanging unlit from a hook, the child's shape only a smudge of grey at the edge of the frame. Light: soft grey-silver spirit-light from the upper left. Painted as an old memorial portrait: faded and yellowed like an old silk painting, edges darkened, fine cracks. Expression: a slow, kind gaze with the half-open eyelid, a wide soft mouth shaped around an unhurried word, her face calm and warm.
